name: UM Shore Regional Health Student Volunteers
org: University of Maryland Shore Regional Health
note: Re-verified against the health system's own hospital volunteers page on 2026-09-08. Confirmed a student track with an age floor of sixteen and completion of tenth grade, and a choice of year-round or summer-only placement.

offerings.summary: Students aged sixteen and over who have completed tenth grade volunteer at UM Shore Regional Health for at least one shift a week, choosing a year-round or summer-only placement.

loc.venue: University of Maryland Shore Regional Health

other: the programs do not count for academic credit or court-ordered community service

sched.hours_raw: Minimum commitment of one shift per week
sched.dur_raw: Students can choose between year-round or summer-only placement when applying.

app.instructions: Submit an application, then complete a personal interview and the health screenings before orientation.

issues: The page does not say which of the health system's Eastern Shore sites take student volunteers; Easton is recorded as the system's principal hospital campus and should be confirmed.
